input.primary: runtime/task10/tape/{market}/*.csv; original nominal two-provider reconciled evidence
input.extended: runtime/task6/data/accepted; adjusted/revision provenance partial, context only until action review
input.universe: Frozen Task6 US38/KR20, current survivor cohort; no historical all-listed claim
input.B: N>=50 and historical membership/delisting/actions required; not a blocker for S

split.purge: target_end strictly before validation; embargo>=primaryH and known release lag

labels.definition: signal close t; entry open t+1; exit open t+H+1; H-session nominal price return
labels.maturity: Historical S virtual cutoff: exit session strictly before fit boundary; actual receipt clock remains backfill 2026-11 and is never relabeled as past observation. Strict Forward requires exit and source receipt <= actual evaluation clock.
labels.missing: No filling, no own-symbol shift across missing market sessions
labels.primary: Declare per candidate before generation; horizons not universal holding rules
labels.other_types: Intraday/time-series/event primary registered separately with observation and execution timestamp

regime.coverage: Counts/contiguous ranges only; no strategy returns or selected-stock optimization; high vol overlaps

evaluation.Layer1: Pure IC/RankIC/spread or type-appropriate forecast/event metrics, no cash/risk
evaluation.Layer2: Existing replay_targets with preregistered native-aligned holding/targets, fixed exposure and matched baseline; no forced top4
evaluation.Layer3: Same frozen signal with/without existing MA63 plus risk-only baseline
evaluation.selection: Campaign-wide attempts including failures; fixed primary per alpha, reused history diagnostic only; no automatic promotion

forward_fix.scope: Collection/recovery only; unchanged initial contract/models/strategy/old decisions; append technical compatibility receipt
